short_description: Hollowspire (fictional F2P action RPG by Emberline Studios) lost a third of its new-player D7 retention after the Season 7 launch — a boss wall at stage 7-4, 5-8 minute ranked queues in APAC/OCE, and harassment in the new Raid Finder. A Live-Ops Console app scores every player with UC-registered XGBoost churn + LTV models and SHAP drivers, reads the chat moderation queue with AI Functions, and a live-ops copilot sizes the at-risk LTV by segment, prices every intervention with a deterministic plan engine inside the monthly budget (rejecting the blanket gem sale), drafts the player message and schedules the fix — written back to Lakebase + Delta. Live-ops dashboard (D1/D7/D30, ARPDAU, churn by cohort) + Genie on the same tables.
